html:
If you’re looking to tint your windows, whether that be on your car or home or even office, our suggestion is that you get professional window tinting done by a company that specialises in tinting. Get it done right the first time to save you on replacement tint costs.

Professional window tint leaves no bubbles, it won’t peel off, and our tints are made to last. Your local Tint a Car team know specialise in this kind of work and are well equipped to get the job done at a high standard.

Window Tinting Options

We currently offer 6 different options for window tinting:

  • Octane – the darklest legal tint
  • Midnight Express – As black as night
  • Spectre – advanced ceramic film technology
  • Formula 1 – highest SPF 50+ UV protection tint
  • Unbreakable – 7 times thicker than standard film and prevents breakage and break-ins

Avoid your window tint from looking horrible, and have a professional tinting service attend to your vehicle, home or office.

Our Quality Guarantee

Rather than learning how to tint your own car, get a professional to handle it for a clean, long-lasting result. Tint a Car have been in the industry for years and we take pride in our work on all our tint jobs. That’s why we offer a 30 day money back guarantee.

Get a quote for a professional window tint cost by contacting your local Tint a Car store.
